Hey, I'm Cathryn 👋

Founder of BestSelf Co — bootstrapped to $55M+, sold to PE in 2022, bought it back in 2024.

The shift

I spent years hiring developers to build my ideas. Now I build them myself using Claude Code, Codex, and learning more every day.

What I've built

  • diagram-design — 42 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG, with imports from Mermaid, draw.io, and Excalidraw. No shadows. No Mermaid slop. Reached #1 on GitHub Trending in August 2026.

  • openclaw-ops — Operations skill: health checks, repair scripts, watchdogs, update triage, security scans.

  • codex-skill — Give Claude Code a second opinion using OpenAI Codex — automatic plan review via hooks.

  • voice-memo-organizer — Organizes hundreds of Apple Voice Memos into a searchable archive with transcriptions and summaries. No API keys needed.

  • repo-atlas — Builds a persistent context system for any git repo — fast LLM onboarding for agents.

  • agent-improvement-loop — Local session-mining loop for staging AI agent improvements and content ideas.

  • spend-optimizer — Audit subscriptions and optimize credit card rewards.

  • shopify-developer-skill — Shopify expertise for Claude Code — verifies current APIs before coding.

  • problem-solver-skill — Systematic problem diagnosis using progressive disclosure.

  • shiprank — Public leaderboard for developers who ship. Live at shiprank.dev.

Printed CLIs

I use CLI Printing Press to turn APIs into agent-native CLIs and MCP servers. These are my published prints in the public library:

  • AI: Context.dev, ElevenLabs, Mixlayer, TwelveLabs, WaveSpeed, xAI
  • Commerce: Amazon Ads, Amazon Seller, Facebook Marketplace, Shopify, TikTok Shop
  • Marketing: Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, Google Ads, Google Analytics, Judge.me, Judgeme, Kit, Klaviyo, SendFox
  • Cloud + monitoring: Cloud Run Admin, Cloudflare, Tailscale, Sentry
  • Productivity + auth: 1Password, BreezeDoc, Postmark, TidyCal
  • Media + social: Google Photos, Linq, X / Twitter
  • Payments + travel: Mercury, Seats.aero
  • Devices: Vestaboard

Loops is in review as the next public print.

Contributing to

  • openclaw/openclaw — Your own personal AI assistant. Fixed bypassPermissions on custom CLI args, auth token auto-generation during gateway install, launchd kickstart on supervised restart.
  • silverstein/minutes — Privacy-first conversation memory. Unified design system, Xcode build auto-recovery, screen share privacy fix.
  • paperclipai/paperclip — Open-source orchestration for zero-human companies.
  • mvanhorn/cli-printing-press — Contributor to the generator that turns APIs into agent-native CLIs and MCP servers.
  • mvanhorn/printing-press-library — Published the CLIs above and improved the public catalog.
  • openclaw/gogcli — Fixed positional Google Sheets updates so they stay inside the requested range.
  • EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin — Improved platform aggregator lookup in the brainstorming skill.
  • jeffreydebolt/Flowcoach2 and jeffreydebolt/fifo-inventory-system — Added architecture reference documentation.

Writing

I write Little Might — for operators getting technical, and builders learning to operate. I go deep on one hard thing at a time, then write down exactly how to do it yourself.

item.title: Isabel Wu (@wuisabel-gif)
item.description:
Isabel Wu
@wuisabel-gif

Computer Engineering & Computer Science Junior @ USC | Building intelligent systems for robotics, electronics, and tools that make technical work clearer.

120 followers · 48 following

  • USC RPL & USC AUV
  • wuisabel@usc.edu
  • https://wuisabel-gif.github.io

Popular Repository

backroom_level_0 14 2
THE BACKROOMS, Level 0: a browser-based Backrooms maze crawler built in Three.js.

Other Repositories (Pinned)

  • MemWhale 134 30
    Persistent, local memory for developers and their coding agents. Records commands, output, errors, and the fixes that worked into SQLite and serves them over MCP.
  • Cadence 28 4
    Catches writing that sounds robotic. Shows you why, then rewrites it in a voice that sounds like you.
  • Delphin 22 4
    A duplex companion for AI agent CLIs: talk and listen at the same time.
  • plants_vs_zoombies_cpp 13 1
    C++ Remake of Plants vs. Zombies (Just for Fun 🌻🧟)
  • FlashICP 11 1
    A CUDA-accelerated ICP library for high-performance point cloud registration in robotics.

Hi, I'm Isabella 👋

Most of what I build starts as a problem in my own life. The fix is usually more interesting than the problem, so I keep going until it's a tool other people can use too.

I study Computer Engineering and Computer Science at USC, and I work across the whole stack: robots and embedded firmware at the bottom, GPU and ML infrastructure in the middle, developer tools and games at the top.

Jump to: Robotics · Embedded · GPU & ML · Dev Tools · Games · Upstream

🤖 Robotics & Autonomy

🌊 USC AUV, Software Co-Lead. Building localization, state estimation, and mission planning for Barracuda 2.0, our autonomous underwater vehicle: a ROS 2/GTSAM estimator fusing IMU, DVL, depth, and stereo point clouds, plus a behavior-tree mission planner. Three tools came out of that work:

  • AUVSimBench: a ROS 2 physics twin of the vehicle. It publishes the same sensor streams as the real robot, plus ground truth, and can fail a sensor on cue, so we can test the whole stack on a laptop instead of burning pool time
  • FlashICP: CUDA-accelerated point-cloud registration in C++17, heading toward LiDAR odometry on Jetson hardware
  • ThrusterHelper.jl: Julia toolkit for thruster allocation and stress-testing a vehicle's design before it touches water

🔬 Research. CURVE researcher in RoboLAND at USC, working on how legged robots can feel the ground they walk on.

⚡ Embedded & Systems

🚀 USC Rocket Propulsion Lab. Embedded data-acquisition pipelines, sensor drivers, and high-speed telemetry for rocket avionics on STM32 and Mbed OS.

📡 WireDAQ. You shouldn't need the hardware to start. WireDAQ simulates a data-acquisition system end to end so the software and firmware grow against one shared packet contract instead of colliding at bring-up. Python core, C/C++ firmware codec, experimental Rust backend with Lua scenarios, plus WireDAQ Health, a small Nim CLI for checking live or captured telemetry. Live demo · pip install wiredaq

🧠 GPU, ML & Inference

🔴 Morpheus. Most LLM benchmarks report one average and call the service fast. Morpheus measures serving performance on vLLM as a distribution: it separates prefill from decode, finds the concurrency point where throughput stops improving, and flags p99 numbers that don't have enough samples behind them.

🧬 MoA Prediction. A multi-label ML pipeline for predicting how compounds act on cells from 872 gene and cell features, built with NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch. Finished in the top 3% of the Kaggle leaderboard.

⚡ FlashICP (above) for CUDA, and my ONNX Runtime contribution (below) for GPU inference.

🛠️ Developer Tools

🐋 MemWhale. My coding agents kept forgetting what they'd already learned, so I built a local-first terminal memory system that records what actually happened while you debug and serves it back to any agent over MCP. Nothing leaves your machine. cargo install memorywhale-cli

🔀 SwapAI. One shell-first CLI for Ollama, llama.cpp, and vLLM behind a single OpenAI-compatible API. Plain POSIX shell, tested in CI across sh, bash, and dash.

🎵 Cadence. AI writing has a tell. Cadence catches it, shows you exactly why a draft reads as robotic, and rewrites it in a voice you choose. Zero dependencies, and it runs in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, the browser, and the command line. Try the score page with no install.

🎮 Games

I'm passionate about games, and most of mine run in the browser. The 3D ones can take a moment to load, but they get there. Click play and you're in.

🟨 Backrooms Level 0. Level 0 rebuilt in Three.js, with no game engine. The rooms stream in forever, something starts hunting you after about 15 seconds, and the only way out is answering lore questions at the M.E.G. terminals. Sometimes you meet another wanderer. It might be a survivor who helps you, or a Skin-Stealer wearing somebody's face. You have to guess. 📺 Gameplay video

🎓 University of Spoiled Children. A walkable, Roblox-style USC campus that teaches Cal Newport's How to Win at College. Walk up to a signboard to learn a strategy, collect all 16, and you graduate. The whole world is one HTML file, and it works in VR too. ▶ Play · 📺 Devlog

🏨 The Atrium. A first-person haunted hotel you explore by lantern light: an Art Deco corridor lined with twelve guest portraits, each with its own unsettling story, and paintings you can step through into the rooms behind them. It doubles as my AI-assisted 3D asset pipeline: the furniture is generated with Modly, the UI with a ChatGPT image model, and the lantern, flickering lights, blackouts, and ambient sound are all generated in the browser with no audio files. ▶ Play (works on touch too)

🔫 Neon Breach. A neon sci-fi roguelike shooter built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Pick a pilot, survive the waves, and unlock bigger weapons. ▶ Play · 📺 Live play demo

🌻 Plants vs. Zombies (C++). My first C++ game: a C++17/SFML remake with plant placement, projectile combat, several zombie types, level progression, and saved progress. 📺 Gameplay video

🐣 Thronglets. Little creatures that live in your terminal, inspired by Black Mirror's "Plaything." They trade ideas when they meet, the ideas mutate as they spread, and a culture forms that you never chose. Feed them, or don't. Written in Rust. cargo run --release · 📺 Video

🛡️ NPC-FSM. An engine-independent NPC behavior library in Squirrel: guards patrol, chase, attack, search, and radio each other for backup. Project site

🔧 Upstream

I contribute to the tools I use.

  • ONNX Runtime (Microsoft): added GRU operator support to the WebGPU backend
  • Mbed CE: bug fixes, hardware support, and security-library upgrades
  • RocketPy: fixed a delayed-thrust rail takeoff bug and hardened the VTK animation tests
  • Rerun: clearer errors for glTF/GLB models that need unsupported compression extensions
  • Proton-GE: fixed a crash in Star Citizen's message-box hook so the game runs on Linux
  • Modly: added a headless deployment guide for the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin
  • rho (16 PRs) and CodeWhale (14 PRs): regular contributor to these open-source Rust agent harnesses
  • Jan and LocalAI: merged security fixes

🔌 Teaching

I am the learning assistant for USC's TAC 348: Making Smart Devices, helping students through embedded hardware, sensors, circuits, and connected-device projects.

Let's build something

💬 Everything here is open source. PRs are welcome. Half-formed idea or a specific question? Open an issue and let's talk it through.

📚 Convictions · Writing

Hi, I'm Ayaan

Co-founder/CTO at Crossroads and a maintainer of OpenClaw (~383k ⭐). Former Google Summer of Code contributor with CERN on the ALICE experiment. Into scalable systems, performance work, bots, embedded tinkering, and aircraft.

Projects I Built

Systems & tools

  • 📻 chanson.live: Ultra-low-latency WebRTC radio for listening together without noticeable desync.
  • 🔒 agentwall: macOS sandbox for AI coding agents with file and network approval controls.
  • 🖥️ shelleport: Browser-based remote control for AI coding sessions on any machine.
  • 🤖 SuperSeriousBot: Telegram bot with APIs and chat-management features, used by 5,000+ people.
  • 🖼️ musee: Fast self-hosted image gallery that ships minimal JavaScript.
  • ⚡ pong: TUI that pings AWS regions around the world and shows the latency spread.
  • 🐍 uvlift: Interactive dependency updater for Python projects using uv.
  • 📚 anki-mcp: CLI MCP server for Anki via AnkiConnect.
  • 💸 ynab-mcp: CLI MCP server for YNAB.
  • 📝 codex-changelog: Release-to-post automation for openai/codex changelogs.
  • 🧾 india-tax: Simple India income-tax calculator comparing the current and proposed regimes.

For the fun of it

  • ✈️ pilane-web: DIY plane-spotting project using YOLO and an old Android phone.
  • 🎮 playtime-panorama: Dense, responsive collage of your Steam library with tile sizes driven by playtime.
  • 🗳️ gotm-remix: Game of the Month voting site for the Patient Gamers Discord server.
  • 🏎️ HamVerBot: F1 bot for #f1 on Libera.Chat.
  • 🎞️ trilbys-archive: Searchable archive of Zero Punctuation and Fully Ramblomatic transcripts.
  • 💉 vnb: Rust Telegram bot for monitoring CoWin vaccination slot availability.
  • 😵 spurdify: Python library that converts text into Spurdo-style nonsense.

OSS I Contribute To

  • 🦞 OpenClaw (~383k ⭐): Personal AI assistant across platforms; one of the main projects I maintain and contribute to.
  • 📈 openclaw-rtt: Round-trip-timing harness and auto-published dashboard measuring real agent reply latency across Discord, Telegram, Slack, and WhatsApp.
  • 🧰 clawhub: Skill and plugin registry for OpenClaw.
  • ⚛️ AliceO2Group/Control: ALICE experiment control system; part of my CERN / GSoC work.
  • ⚡ Bun: JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager.
